subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the adult woman from <Picture 1>, with a slender build, medium-brown hair tied in a loose high bun, tired but focused eyes, loose white hospital pajamas with thin pale-blue vertical stripes, and bare feet. Preserve her facial identity, hairstyle, proportions, pajama pattern, and bare feet.
<Subject 2> is the stocky adult man from <Picture 2>, with short messy black hair, round wire-frame glasses, light moustache and chin stubble, a broad build, a plain black T-shirt, loose black trousers, and black athletic shoes. Preserve his facial identity, glasses, facial hair, body proportions, clothing, and footwear.

summary:
[reference generation] The target video is a five-second extremely intense fighting-game-style battle between <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> in an empty hospital corridor. Use large full-body movements, explosive dashes, ground-smashing attacks, wall-assisted aerial kicks, powerful counters, fast recoveries, and a final simultaneous attack clash. Add attack trails, afterimages, hit sparks, shockwave rings, impact freezes, screen shake, light flicker, chromatic aberration, and flying debris. No weapons, blood, gore, health bars, or unrelated patients appear.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her face, brown hair bun, slender proportions, striped hospital pajamas, and bare feet remain consistent.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - his face, messy black hair, glasses, facial stubble, broad proportions, black clothing, and black shoes remain consistent.

detailed_description:
The target video uses realistic live-action cinematography combined with exaggerated premium fighting-game action. A continuous medium-wide side-view camera keeps both full bodies visible and maintains a clear left-right combat axis: <Subject 1> primarily occupies screen left and <Subject 2> screen right. The camera performs fast horizontal tracking, sudden impact push-ins, localized shake, and rapid pullbacks during aerial motion.

The empty hospital corridor contains pale walls, closed doors, stainless-steel handrails, an abandoned medical cart, polished flooring, flickering fluorescent ceiling lights, and a distant red emergency lamp. Every major attack produces colored speed trails, translucent body afterimages, bright blue-white or amber impact sparks, expanding circular shockwaves, flying dust, and brief chromatic distortion. Keep anatomy coherent, contact points readable, and clothing stable.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, both fighters hold low combat stances. A thin energy outline flashes around their silhouettes. At 00:00.400, <Subject 2> explosively dashes forward across several meters, leaving three dark-red afterimages. He leaps, raises both fists overhead, and brings them down in a huge two-handed ground-smashing attack.

At approximately 00:01.100, <Subject 1> drops into a fast knee slide and passes underneath his descending arms by a narrow margin. His fists strike the polished floor behind her, producing a violent camera shake, a wide amber shockwave, fractured floor tiles, a burst of dust, and a brief fluorescent-light blackout. The medical cart jumps slightly from the impact.

Without stopping, <Subject 1> rises from the slide, takes two running steps up the corridor wall, and launches high into the air. Multiple pale-blue afterimages trace her curved path. She rotates her entire body in a large spinning arc and delivers a fully extended flying heel kick toward <Subject 2>'s upper body.

At 00:02.300, <Subject 2> crosses both forearms and blocks the kick. Use a four-frame impact freeze: her leg is fully extended, his guard compresses against his chest, a bright blue-white starburst fills the contact point, a circular pressure wave expands down the corridor, ceiling dust falls, and the camera pushes rapidly toward them. Resume at full speed as he slides backward several meters.

At 00:02.800, <Subject 2> immediately drives upward with a massive rising uppercut. <Subject 1> crosses both forearms in front of her torso and blocks, but the force lifts her completely into the air. Add a thick vertical orange attack trail, strong screen shake, sparks around her guard, and a brief upward camera tilt.

Between 00:03.300 and 00:04.100, <Subject 1> converts the upward force into a full backward somersault. Her pajamas and loose hair follow the rotation naturally. She lands in a deep crouch, one hand touching the floor, and a pale-blue dust ring bursts beneath her bare feet. <Subject 2> lands heavily opposite her and immediately raises his fists.

At 00:04.200, both fighters launch toward the center simultaneously. <Subject 2> throws a huge straight punch while <Subject 1> drives forward with an open-palm strike. Red and blue speed lines fill opposite sides of the corridor as the camera pulls back to preserve both silhouettes.

At 00:04.800, their fist and palm collide at the exact center of the frame. Create the largest impact effect of the sequence: a white-hot core, blue-and-red radial sparks, a transparent spherical shockwave, violent but localized camera shake, rippling reflections across the floor, flickering lights, and flying paper from the medical cart. End exactly at 00:05.000 on a dramatic fighting-game impact freeze with both characters locked in the clash.

overall_soundscape:
The fluorescent hum is overwhelmed by explosive dashes, clothing snaps, bare-foot slides, heavy shoe impacts, wall steps, airborne whooshes, blocked strikes, floor fractures, rattling medical equipment, electrical crackles, and deep expanding shockwave booms. Each major hit has a distinct bass-heavy impact sound.

non_diegetic_music:
Very fast industrial percussion with taiko drums, distorted bass, aggressive electronic pulses, and short brass blasts. The music repeatedly cuts out during impact freezes, surges during aerial motion, and ends on a massive synchronized downbeat at the final clash.
